notes.subject: fix(terminal): run approved commands on Linux and remote hosts
notes.summary: Approved agent commands now run in a VS Code terminal on Linux, Windows and remote hosts instead of failing before launch; sandbox-only requests and untrusted workspaces stay blocked.
